answer: Proof-of-burn mechanisms mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to irreversibly destroy base currency into unspendable addresses to mint identity tickets. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of permanently liquidating capital per persona, whether deployed across shale terrain, a juniper grove, or a grassy meadow. However, this creates a plutocratic barrier favoring well-funded adversaries while imposing deadweight economic loss on genuine participants.
